svg.title: RewardShield — research
svg.desc: RewardShield, a pre-registered study of how often SQL execution rewards accept wrong queries. False-accept share on the dev-A audit split: AgentTune 1.1.5 (1 db) 4.31%; single-1 (1 db) 3.88%; random-4 (4 db) 3.13%; targeted-4 (4 db) 1.39%; random-16 (16 db) 1.0%. 1,360 agent trajectories, labelled by an independent Spider test-suite oracle Better-filtered fine-tuning data: no measurable change (−1.06 pts, CI spans 0) Upstream: my fix merged in AgentTune #22; root-cause fix shipped in agenttune 1.1.7 Registered seeds. Averaged over 200 database draws, targeted-4 beats random-4 by 0.25 pts on dev-A and 1.57 pts on held-out schemas.
